scope: Offline installed-operator startup and authenticated descriptor observation through actual native encrypted retained-store clients against explicit synthetic Vault/S3 HTTP boundaries.

repository_reproducer.prerequisites: Linux mount/network namespaces, OpenSSL, iproute2/util-linux, noninteractive sudo; privilege is dropped before fixture/operator execution. No live cluster or AWS credentials.

source_identity_scope: The operator/library source at the recorded run, before publication of this fixture and recording. Fixture source/binary are independently identified.

postconditions.positive: Exact retained phase, original descriptor and configured pin are returned through real peer refresh, signed frames and HTTP listener. Admission/marker ciphertext bytes remain identical. Only the registered replay record may be written by authentication.
postconditions.refusal: The real operator exits1 without retained mutation or state initialization.
postconditions.cleanup: Every operator process is stopped and joined before exact listener-port release is asserted; service workers are linked/joined and private namespaces and temporary synthetic key material are released.

actual_boundaries: Production retained-record codecs and AEAD envelope open/seal
Native SigV4 S3 GET and conditional ETag replay writes
Actual signed client/peer refresh/frame verifier/descriptor handler
explicit_fixture_boundaries: Vault login/token/Transit and KV HTTP responses
In-memory S3 provider objects behind native HTTP requests
Synthetic public caller inventory and initial pure quiesced migration state
Synthetic projected Kubernetes CA; no live Kubernetes API observation
excluded_claims: real Vault/IAM/S3 provider authorization or policy
physical registry publication or pin retirement
backup/restore, native key/session retirement or other roles/origins
live cutover, AWS absence, defect-class closure or deployment qualification
prior_fixture_corrections: Missing projected CA was supplied only inside private mounts.
Distinct peer and descriptor nonces replaced a reused nonce.
Authentication replay writes were separated from immutable domain birth records in the oracle.
An early process wrapper returned before listener release; typed-process stop/join now precedes the cleanup assertion.
